_comment: CommandCode /alpha response shapes. Placeholders only, no real credential. The routes answer flat OR wrapped once in `data`; both are represented here.
_monthly_note: The monthly percentage needs BOTH monthlyCredits (remaining) and usage/summary.totalCredits (spent). With this fixture: spent 5.75, remaining 4.25, cap 10 -> 57.5% used.

_wrapped_variant.note: The same payload wrapped in `data` must parse identically. The adapter checks the direct key first and only then `data`, so an empty envelope cannot shadow a real top-level value.
